engine.trust.reason.neglect: {region} has had no card for 8 years.
engine.trust.reason.repairs_overdue: The repairs you put off are still not done.
engine.rule.neglect: A region feels forgotten if no card reaches it for 8 years. A card for all of Wales reaches every region.
engine.visit.stitched: Already made safe on an earlier visit, so they count: {tips}.
engine.visit.exposure.pass: Did you protect enough homes? Yes. Your picks protect about {got} in 10 of the homes below the tips. You needed {needed} in 10.
engine.visit.exposure.fail: Did you protect enough homes? Not yet. Your picks protect about {got} in 10 of the homes below the tips. You needed {needed} in 10. {best} has the most homes below it.
engine.visit.fairness.pass: Did you help the poorest streets? Yes. {tip} sits above streets in the poorest tenth of Wales ({edition}).
engine.visit.fairness.fail: Did you help the poorest streets? Not yet. None of your picks sits above the poorest tenth of Wales ({edition}). {best} does.
engine.visit.lifelines.none: Are the schools and the railway safe? Yes. No high-risk tip sits above a school or the railway.
engine.visit.lifelines.pass: Are the schools and the railway safe? Yes. You made {covered} of the {total} high-risk tips above them safe.
engine.visit.lifelines.fail: Are the schools and the railway safe? Not yet. You needed at least {need} of the {total} high-risk tips above them. Still at risk: {missing}.
engine.visit.aros.pass: Can young people stay? Yes, about {runs} times in 10. Homes: {homes}. Work: {work}.
engine.visit.aros.fail: Can young people stay? Not yet. It worked about {runs} times in 10, and it needs 6. You need a homes pick and a work pick that both work. Homes: {homes}. Work: {work}.
engine.visit.iaith.pass: Is Welsh still heard on the street? Yes, about {runs} times in 10. Help for Welsh: {iaith}.
engine.visit.iaith.fail: Is Welsh still heard on the street? Not yet. It worked about {runs} times in 10, and it needs 6. Pick something that helps Welsh. Help for Welsh: {iaith}.
engine.visit.pwysau.pass: Can the valley cope? Yes, about {runs} times in 10.
engine.visit.pwysau.fail: Can the valley cope? Not yet. It coped about {runs} times in 10, and it needs 6. The strain: {pressure}. The river needed: {river}.
engine.visit.room_for_river: a pick that gives the river room
engine.letter.named.tip_safe: {tip} is grass now. Somebody chose it, and I know it was you.
engine.letter.named.visit: They still talk about the year you came to {place} and asked where to start.
engine.letter.named.pledge_kept: You made {count} promises out loud and kept {kept}. People here count.
engine.letter.named.pledge_broken: You promised us {thing} in {year}. We remember the year better than the promise.
engine.letter.named.debt: We are still paying back the loans from {years}.
engine.letter.named.repairs: The repairs put off in {year} were never done. We have been doing them since.
engine.letter.named.neglect: {thing} waited the whole time for something of its own.
engine.letter.named.card: What I can still point to is {thing}, from {year}.
engine.letter.named.arrival: {thing} arrived in {year}, after you had gone. It counts.
engine.letter.named.lost_term: The years you were out of office, from {year}, are still the first thing people mention.
engine.visit.stitched_beth: Already in place from an earlier visit, so they count: {tips}.
engine.visit.very_well: Every test passed, with room to spare.
engine.visit.room.rhondda: Every test passed. For room to spare, protect {needed} in 10 of the homes. Help {tips} of the poorest streets. Make every school and railway tip safe.
engine.visit.room.bethesda: Every test passed. For room to spare, each test must pass about {share} times in 10.
engine.letter.named.debt.one: We are still paying back the loan from {year}.
